commercialPurpose: Create an object-first product stage where a single product close-up carries the whole first impression.
purposeLayer: Hero pattern is useful when the product form factor and craftsmanship must be inspected before copy density appears.
anatomyLayer: Isolated oversized watch/product close-up on a black/white field, no visible supporting page modules, strong product angle, and clear hardware detail focus.
hierarchyLayer: Product object is first and nearly total focus; any copy or CTA should remain secondary and minimal.
gridRhythmLayer: Single-object macro product stage with almost no surrounding interface density.
densityLimitLayer: Use section density limit: {"primaryMessage": 1, "cta": "1-2", "proofCue": "0-1 controlled cue", "mediaSystem": 1}.
originalityLayer: Extract section grammar only; do not copy exact artwork, imagery, spacing, copy, color identity, brand marks, product photos, or page order.
usageRuleLayer: Use for wearables, watches, tech hardware, jewelry, luxury goods, and product launches requiring inspection-level imagery.
layoutGesture: macro product close-up hero with isolated object stage
sectionSilhouette: large product photo fills most of the canvas with stark background contrast
compositionTension: object inspection replaces layout density as persuasion
focalPath: product face/detail to product silhouette to optional CTA
negativeSpaceShape: empty background around the object creates showroom focus
depthLayering: photo object layer over simple black/white base, minimal or no cards
moduleScaleVariation: one huge product object contrasted with tiny or absent controls
breakoutBehavior: product image may crop or break the viewport edge intentionally
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact watch product, crop, angle, reflections, or hardware details.
